source_title: Systems and methods for improved interruption and resumption management (US20230101589A1 / US12327208B2)
possible_relevance: Pre-P1 AI interruption/resumption system monitors user task state and situational/user state, saves current task state and context at interruption, restores software status and refocus context at resume, considers worklist/time/shift/environment, adapts resumption output when situation/device changes, and uses escalation when the paused task situation changes. Strong adverse pressure against generic user-state-aware task continuity, saved resume state/context, environment-sensitive resumption, and changed-situation resume behavior in Claims 9-14.
notes: The 2023 publication safely predates P1. Description states the engine monitors current user activity/situation; saves task state and context when interrupted; can restore exact software status/screens; uses interruption type, worklist, time of day, shift, environment and user feedback in ready-to-resume output; and includes an escalation engine that reacts if the paused task situation changes. Claim 17 expressly saves task state/context and returns software status on resume. This materially weakens any argument that user-state-aware pause/resume or situation-sensitive resumption is independently inventive. It does not facially disclose operative Claim 9's full three-state architecture or the exact limitation that a changed separately maintained Person State causes recomputation of currently feasible next actions while the workstream's progress state remains non-advanced/frozen. Combine adversarially with MI-0004 (stateful runtime/checkpoint), MI-0006 (inferred user state changing workflow behavior), MI-0007 (stored workstreams), and MI-0010 (AI checkpoint rehydration). Preserve for IDS/materiality review; no §102 anticipation conclusion recorded.

It materially increases §103 combination pressure with MI-0004/0005/0006/0007/0010/0011. Preserve for limitation-level charting and IDS/materiality review; no §102 anticipation conclusion recorded.

source_title: Generating Proactive Content for Assistant Systems (US20210117214A1)
possible_relevance: Pre-P1 assistant architecture separately tracks user state and task state, uses current state to generate candidate tasks, consults user memory/task history/knowledge graph, resolves entities, uses agents, applies privacy/policy checks, and changes proactive action selection when user context changes. Material pressure against treating separate user/task state, context-triggered candidate-action recomputation, user-memory/task-history retrieval, entity resolution, or policy-constrained assistant action selection as individually inventive in Claims 1 and 9.
notes: Google Patents records 2019-10-18 prior-art/priority date, 2020-08-28 U.S. filing, and 2021-04-22 publication. Disclosure expressly states that both user state (e.g. current activity) and task state are tracked and that, given current state, a dialog-state tracker suggests candidate tasks; candidate tasks feed an action selector. It also uses user memory, user task history, knowledge graph, user context, entity resolution, multiple agents, and privacy settings/policies. This is strong §103 component pressure for Claims 1 and 9, especially combined with MI-0011 pause/resume and MI-0004 checkpoint persistence. It does not facially establish Claim 9's exact preserved/non-advanced workstream progress state under changed Person State, nor Claim 1's complete machine-bounded world-slice plus transcript-separated durable persistence combination. No §102 anticipation conclusion recorded; preserve for IDS/materiality review.

source_title: Automated network change system (US11018994B2 family; EP3913861A1)
possible_relevance: Pre-P1 workflow/failover system stores verified and in-progress workflow states, restores the last verified state after failure, permits a workflow to continue to a next intent after recovery, and can reapply an in-progress state or roll back to the verified state. Material adverse pressure against treating 'last verified state', stored workflow recovery state, or generic resume/rollback from persisted verified state as distinguishing Claim 9 features.
notes: Google patent-family records trace priority to 2017-12-05. The disclosure defines verified state as the fabric intent applied and verified by a verification runner, stores verified/in-progress states in a database, restores the last verified intent after failover, and lets workflow choose reapply or rollback. This is not facial anticipation of operative Claim 9: it lacks the separately stored changing Person State, Person-State operational constraint, selection of a different executable action while the workstream remains paused/frozen, and later resumption when a third Person State permits the original execution action. It materially strengthens §103 combination pressure with MI-0011/MI-0013 for the verified-state/workflow-recovery components. Preserve for IDS/materiality review; no §102 anticipation conclusion recorded.
